ex.en: The new machine improved the yield of the production line.
ex.zh: 新機器提升了生產線的良率。

ex.en: This year's rice yield was higher than expected.
ex.zh: 今年的稻米產量比預期高。

ex.en: A 6% yield is guaranteed on the investment.
ex.zh: 這項投資保證有 6% 的收益。

ex.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
ex.zh: 他們的投資得到 8% 的收益。

ex.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
ex.zh: 綠燈時，轉彎車輛必須禮讓行人。

ex.en: Because he was just like a child, he yielded to temptation.
ex.zh: 他像個孩子一樣，抵擋不住誘惑。
持續的努力一定會帶來成功。

ex.en: The experiment yielded some surprising results.
ex.zh: 這個實驗得出了一些出乎意料的結果。
